verdict.rationale: The Gemini API is built around natural-language input: it handles text, multimodal and live voice interaction and conversational agents, and function calling turns language into tool actions (gemini-docs-2, gemini-docs-3, gemini-docs-6). Official Gemini API Skills let AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor write correct API code from language prompts (gemini-docs-12, gemini-gh-1, gemini-gh-2). However, using the API still requires code or SDK calls, and nothing shows the product itself being configured or managed through natural-language commands. Missing for 10: natural-language operation of the product itself (keys, quotas, settings, deployments) without writing code, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
